Why our range is small

We are asked fairly often why there are nine products on this site rather than ninety. The short answer is that we only make things we have needed ourselves and could not buy.

The longer answer is that a large range is mostly a marketing decision. It gives you something new to announce every month and it fills a catalogue. It also means most of what you sell is a variation you have not tested properly.

We would rather keep the Ridgeline in the line for six years and change it twice than release a new one every spring.
